description: Write a full design export of a node (default: the selection) to a JSON file: the node tree with every layout, paint, text, variable, style, component and interaction detail, icon SVGs, renders of masked or rotated groups, image fills and a 2x preview. Mapped components carry their code component. Use it to hand a frame to a build script.

fileKey.description: The key of the Figma file. Accepted for compatibility; the file open in Figma Desktop is always used.

nodeId.description: The ID of the node, eg. "123:456" or "123-456" (instance ids like "I1:2;3:4" work too). Omit it to use the current selection in Figma.

path.description: Absolute .json path to write (default: the data folder).

name: save_design_export
title: Save Design Export
